changes: Workout results hold only that workout's ticks: ticks on one of its blocks plus ticks logged after it started. When a climber adds a workout to a session already running, the climbs from before it are left out, and session.startedAt and durationSeconds start at the workout.

blockIndex now follows the block the climber's session recorded each tick on, so a climb queued in two blocks, or also in the climber's own block, lands on the right one instead of null or a guess. The results shape is unchanged.
Add scoped workout creation, listing, retrieval and cancellation with idempotency, lifecycle states and climber-owned results.
Publish workouts:read and workouts:write; existing tokens keep their original scopes.
Grade examples show the board's own label as its grade table spells it (6b+/V4).
climb.boardseshGrade is documented as always null for now: its V-scale form is not published yet.
First draft of v1: GET /v1/me, DELETE /v1/connection, GET /v1/logbook/changes and GET /v1/logbook/ticks/{id}, with the logbook:read, profile:read and offline_access scopes.
